definitions.explanation: The state of being dirty or unhygienic, either physically or morally.

examples.japanese: {不潔|ふけつ}⟦な→な：noentry⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: An unsanitary environment can cause illness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不潔|ふけつ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}→食中毒：07020_shokuchuudoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりやすい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If your hands are unclean, you're more likely to get food poisoning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{不潔|ふけつ}だ。

notes:
{不潔|ふけつ} is the opposite of {清潔|せいけつ} (clean).

Usage:
- {不潔|ふけつ}な + noun (dirty/unclean [noun])
- [noun]は{不潔|ふけつ}だ ([noun] is dirty)

Contrast:
- {不潔|ふけつ} (unclean) vs {清潔|せいけつ} (clean/hygienic)
- {汚|きたな}い (dirty - more colloquial) vs {不潔|ふけつ} (unhygienic - more formal/clinical)

{不潔|ふけつ} emphasizes the lack of hygiene, while {汚|きたな}い is more general for 'dirty'.
